svg.title: We went looking for every council's spending. Nine could be read.
svg.text: 361 UK councils. 82 have a spending dataset in a
catalogue; 20 had a link that returned data; 9 yielded
transactions between them. The Transparency Code asks for
a monthly file, not a readable one, and this is what that
analysis/spending: 193 datasets selected, 7,180 files fetched, parse census in REPORT.md — 354 CSVs were HTML, 570 the wrong genre
